sources.entry: Thaw - Actively maintained menu bar manager for macOS 26+: hide and show items, search, hotkeys, profiles, and appearance controls.

summary.one_liner: Thaw is a free, open source (GPL-3.0) menu bar manager for macOS that hides, reveals, searches, and rearranges menu bar items.
summary.what_it_does: Hides menu bar icons behind a section (with an optional always-hidden section) and reveals them on hover, click, scroll, swipe, or hotkey. Provides a search panel to find and activate any menu bar item from the keyboard, plus drag-and-drop arrangement, groups, and custom spacers. Profiles save whole configurations and can be bound to a display, Space, or Focus filter. Triggers reveal or hide items based on conditions such as battery, Wi-Fi network, Focus, or a script's exit code, and Zen mode conceals everything with one action. Appearance options cover tint, gradient, shadow, border, and custom bar shapes, and a separate Thaw Bar can show hidden items below the menu bar. Actions are also exposed as thaw:// deep links for launchers and automation.
use_cases: hide unused menu bar icons on a Mac
search and activate menu bar items from the keyboard
switch menu bar layouts by display, Space, or Focus
automate menu bar actions from a launcher or script
style the menu bar with tint or gradient
keep menu bar icons usable on a notched MacBook
how_to_run: macOS 14 or 15: download Thaw 1 from the releases page and drag to Applications
Grant Accessibility on first launch (and Menu Bar Layout Access on macOS 27)
Optionally grant Screen Recording for live item previews and wallpaper tinting
notable: Open source under GPL-3.0 with signed, notarized releases and OpenSSF Best Practices Gold badge
Thaw Bar displays hidden items in a separate bar for notched MacBooks
Triggers for conditions like battery, Wi-Fi, Focus, camera/mic in use, or script result
Every core action available as a thaw:// deep link, with an official Raycast extension
caveats: Requires Accessibility permission; Screen Recording is optional but needed for live item previews
Hiding relies on PlatformRuntimeKit, a closed-source component, though the README says linking with it is permitted under GPL section 7
Some Thaw 3 features are beta only (macOS 27), and some languages are only in the development branch
Supports macOS 14 and later only through the older Thaw 1 release; current features target macOS 26 and 27
